items.source:
The SpEL expression evaluates against a dedicated context that provides the
following meta-data:
items.translation: SpEL 表达式针对一个提供以下元数据的专用上下文进行评估：

items.source: #root.method, #root.target, and #root.caches for references to the method, target object, and affected cache(s) respectively.
items.translation: #root.method、#root.target 和 #root.caches 分别用于引用 method、目标对象以及受影响的缓存。

items.source: Method arguments can be accessed by index. For instance the second argument can be accessed via #root.args[1], #p1 or #a1. Arguments can also be accessed by name if that information is available.
items.translation: 方法参数可以通过索引访问。例如，第二个参数可以通过 `#root.args[1]`、`#p1` 或 `#a1` 访问。如果该信息可用，也可以通过名称访问参数。

items.source: Shortcuts for the method name (#root.methodName) and target class (#root.targetClass) are also available.
items.translation: 方法名（#root.methodName）和目标类（#root.targetClass）的快捷方式也可用。

items.source: Each time an advised method is invoked, caching behavior will be applied, checking whether the method has been already invoked for the given arguments. A sensible default simply uses the method parameters to compute the key, but a SpEL expression can be provided via the key() attribute, or a custom KeyGenerator implementation can replace the default one (see keyGenerator()).
items.translation: 每次调用一个被代理的方法时，都会应用缓存行为，检查该方法是否已经针对给定的参数被调用过。合理的默认实现是使用方法参数来计算键，但可以通过 `key()` 属性提供 SpEL 表达式，或者使用自定义的 KeyGenerator 实现来替换默认实现（参见 `keyGenerator()`）。

items.source: If no value is found in the cache for the computed key, the target method will be invoked and the returned value will be stored in the associated cache. Note that Optional return types are unwrapped automatically. If an Optional value is present, it will be stored in the associated cache. If an Optional value is not present, null will be stored in the associated cache.
items.translation: 如果缓存中未找到计算键对应的值，将调用目标方法，并将返回的值存储到关联的缓存中。请注意，Optional 返回类型会自动解包。如果 Optional 值存在，它将存储到关联的缓存中。如果 Optional 值不存在，则会将 null 存储到关联的缓存中。

items.source: Names may be used to determine the target cache(s), to be resolved via the configured cacheResolver() which typically delegates to CacheManager.getCache(String).
items.translation: 名称可用于确定目标缓存，这些缓存将通过配置的 cacheResolver() 进行解析，该解析器通常委托给 CacheManager.getCache(String)。

items.source: Default is "", meaning all method parameters are considered as a key, unless a custom keyGenerator() has been configured.
items.translation: 默认为 `""`，表示所有方法参数均被视为键，除非已配置自定义的keyGenerator()。

items.source: Unlike condition(), this expression is evaluated after the method has been called and can therefore refer to the result.
items.translation: 与condition()不同，此表达式在方法调用之后求值，因此可以引用result。

items.source: Mutually exclusive with the key() attribute.
items.translation: 与key()属性互斥。

items.source: Mutually exclusive with the cacheResolver() attribute.
items.translation: 与cacheResolver()属性互斥。

items.source: Intended to be used when no other attributes are needed, for example: @Cacheable("books").
items.translation: 打算在不需要其他属性时使用，例如： @Cacheable("books")。

items.source: Default is "", meaning the method result is always cached.
items.translation: 默认值为 `""`，表示该方法的结果始终被缓存。

items.source: Default is "", meaning that caching is never vetoed.
items.translation: 默认值为 `""`，表示缓存永远不会被否决。

items.source:
This will usually be a single cache name. If multiple names are specified,
they will be consulted for a cache hit in the order of definition, and they
will all receive a put/evict request for the same newly cached value.
items.translation: 这通常是一个单一的缓存名称。如果指定了多个名称，它们将按定义顺序被查询以检查缓存命中情况，并且它们都会收到针对同一新缓存值的 put/evict 请求。

items.source:
Note that asynchronous/reactive cache access may not fully consult all
specified caches, depending on the target cache. In the case of late-determined
cache misses (for example, with Redis), further caches will not get consulted anymore.
As a consequence, specifying multiple cache names in an async cache mode setup
only makes sense with early-determined cache misses (for example, with Caffeine).
items.translation: 请注意，异步/响应式缓存访问可能不会完全咨询所有指定的缓存，具体取决于目标缓存。对于延迟确定的缓存未命中情况（例如使用 Redis），将不再咨询其他缓存。因此，在异步缓存模式配置中指定多个缓存名称仅对早期确定的缓存未命中情况（例如使用 Caffeine）有意义。

items.source:
Synchronize the invocation of the underlying method if several threads are attempting to load a value for the same key. The synchronization leads to a couple of limitations:
  1. unless() is not supported
  2. Only one cache may be specified
  3. No other cache-related operation can be combined
This is effectively a hint and the chosen cache provider might not actually support it in a synchronized fashion. Check your provider documentation for more details on the actual semantics.
items.translation:
如果多个线程尝试为同一键加载值，请同步底层方法的调用。同步会导致一些限制：
  1. 不支持unless()
  2. 只能指定一个缓存
  3. 不能组合其他与缓存相关的操作
这实际上只是一个提示，所选的缓存提供者可能并不真正支持同步方式。请查看提供者的文档以获取有关实际语义的更多详细信息。

items.source: The bean name of the custom CacheManager to use to create a default CacheResolver if none is set already.
items.translation: 用于在尚未设置的情况下创建默认CacheResolver的自定义CacheManager的 bean 名称。

items.source: The bean name of the custom CacheResolver to use.
items.translation: 要使用的自定义CacheResolver的 bean 名称。

items.source: The bean name of the custom KeyGenerator to use.
items.translation: 要使用的自定义KeyGenerator的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Alias for cacheNames().
items.translation: `cacheNames()` 的别名。

items.source: #result for a reference to the result of the method invocation. For supported wrappers such as Optional, #result refers to the actual object, not the wrapper
items.translation: `#result` 用于引用方法调用的结果。对于支持的包装器（如 `Optional`），`#result` 指代实际对象，而非包装器本身。

items.source: Costin Leau, Phillip Webb, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Costin Leau, Phillip Webb, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建具有属性覆盖的自定义 组合注解。

items.source: Names of the caches in which method invocation results are stored.
items.translation: 存储方法调用结果的缓存名称。

items.source:
Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expression used for making the method
caching conditional.
items.translation: 用于使方法缓存条件化的 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 表达式。

items.source: Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expression for computing the key dynamically.
items.translation: 用于动态计算键的 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 表达式。

items.source:
Synchronize the invocation of the underlying method if several threads are
attempting to load a value for the same key.
items.translation: 如果多个线程尝试为同一键加载值，请同步底层方法的调用。

items.source: Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expression used to veto method caching.
items.translation: 用于否决方法缓存的 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 表达式。

items.translation: 可选元素摘要
